The prophecy tells that an adventurer bearing the name of [@STRING($EB(1))] will slay the guano gnats of western Thanalan, and thereby obtain the legendary [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000556,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000556,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Travel north of Nophica's Wells in western Thanalan, and there kill guano gnats near the entrance to the Copperbell Mines to see if there truly is such a gem to be had.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Yayake of Arrzaneth Ossuary has asked you to ascertain the truth of a prophecy being spoken by one Ququruka, a prisoner who claims to hear the voice of Nald'thal. The prophecy tells that an adventurer bearing the name of [@STRING($EB(1))] will slay the guano gnats of western Thanalan, and thereby obtain the legendary [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000556,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000556,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Travel north of Nophica's Wells in western Thanalan, and there kill guano gnats near the entrance to the Copperbell Mines to see if there truly is such a gem to be had.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
After slaying several guano gnats, an Amalj'aa named Kazagg Chah appeared and presented you with the Gem of Shatotto. Return to Arrzaneth Ossuary and speak to Yayake.
※ The next black mage quest will be available from Lalai upon reaching level 35.

At Milvaneth Sacrarium, Lalai has imparted to you the next prophecy foretold by Ququruka. When a new light shines from the black mage's testimony that you carry, you are to obtain the key to reseal the Voidgate. To fulfill this prophecy, you must travel west of Nophica's Wells in western Thanalan. Once there, find and slay the beast known as Daddy Longlegs.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

At Milvaneth Sacrarium, Lalai has imparted to you the next prophecy foretold by Ququruka. When a new light shines from the black mage's testimony that you carry, you are to obtain the key to reseal the Voidgate. To fulfill this prophecy, you must travel west of Nophica's Wells in western Thanalan. Once there, find and slay the beast known as Daddy Longlegs.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
※ The next black mage quest will be available from Lalai upon reaching level 40.

Lalai has handed down yet another prophecy from her Master. You are to travel west of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan, to a cave not found on any map. In its depths, you must locate an Amalj'aa named Kazagg Chah. Show him the testimony you carry, and gain his allegiance.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Lalai has handed down yet another prophecy from her Master. You are to travel west of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan, to a cave not found on any map. In its depths, you must locate an Amalj'aa named Kazagg Chah. Show him the testimony you carry, and gain his allegiance.

West of Camp Horizon, you find the same Amalj'aa who presented you with the Gem of Shatotto. Known as Kazagg Chah, he claims that a prophecy spoken by his great-grandfather led him to this land to see you undertake a trial that would lead to your awakening. As part of this trial, you are to travel south of Camp Bald Knoll in western La Noscea and there slay the beast known as Whitetalon. Kazagg Chah warns that she is a cautious foe, and will first set her minions upon you. Prepare yourself for a memorable battle.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
You have succeeded in defeating Whitetalon. Return to Kazagg Chah in western Thanalan and tell him of your accomplishment.
※ The next black mage quest will be available from Dozol Meloc upon reaching level 45.

The Ixal Dozol Meloc tells you that the Gloom emanating from the Voidgate is reacting to the power that has awoken within you. According to him, an ancient black magic that will aid you lies hidden in the Black Shroud, where mages of old sealed it within a stela. Travel to the West Shroud and search for this stela to the northwest of Turning Leaf.

The Ixal Dozol Meloc tells you that the Gloom emanating from the Voidgate is reacting to the power that has awoken within you. According to him, an ancient black magic that will aid you lies hidden in the Black Shroud, where mages of old sealed it within a stela. Travel to the West Shroud and search for this stela to the northwest of Turning Leaf.
※ The next black mage quest is now available from Da Za.

Da Za tells you that he set out from his kobold homeland of O'Ghomoro to pursue the same legend recounted by Kazagg Chah and Dozol Meloc. He holds a stone tablet passed down to him from his ancestor, Da Gu. Upon showing it to you, the light from your Gem of Shatotto reveals writing carved into its surface indicating that closing the Voidgate requires certain [@1A(1)]garb[@1A(0)]. To complete your next task as a mage of the black, travel to the first four locations named and seek out this garb.[@CR]- The Aurum Vale, west of Camp Ever Lakes in the Coerthas central lowlands.[@CR]- Dusk Vigil, north of Camp Riversmeet in the Coerthas western highlands.[@CR]- A cave west of Camp Brittlebark in Mor Dhona.[@CR]- A cave south of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan.

Da Za tells you that he set out from his kobold homeland of O'Ghomoro to pursue the same legend recounted by Kazagg Chah and Dozol Meloc. He holds a stone tablet passed down to him from his ancestor, Da Gu. Upon showing it to you, the light from your Gem of Shatotto reveals writing carved into its surface indicating that closing the Voidgate requires certain [@1A(1)]garb[@1A(0)]. To complete your next task as a mage of the black, travel to the first four locations named and seek out this garb.[@CR]- The Aurum Vale, west of Camp Ever Lakes in the Coerthas central lowlands.[@CR]- Dusk Vigil, north of Camp Riversmeet in the Coerthas western highlands.[@CR]- A cave west of Camp Brittlebark in Mor Dhona.[@CR]- A cave south of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan.
※ The next black mage quest will be available from Da Za upon reaching level 50.

The kobold Da Za returned to his home to inquire after the mysterious [@1A(1)]Solace of the Gods[@1A(0)]. Though he was unable to learn its location, he did learn that his ancestor Da Gu set out in search of it one hundred years ago. Could he too have been searching for the artifacts of the black mage? Go and speak to Dozol Meloc to see if he has uncovered anything new.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

The kobold Da Za returned to his home to inquire after the mysterious [@1A(1)]Solace of the Gods[@1A(0)]. Though he was unable to learn its location, he did learn that his ancestor Da Gu set out in search of it one hundred years ago. Could he too have been searching for the artifacts of the black mage? Go and speak to Dozol Meloc to see if he has uncovered anything new.

Dozol Meloc tells you that his great-grandmother left her home at the same time as Da Za's ancestor, one hundred years ago. Is it possible that some connection exists between the two? Speak with Kazagg Chah to see if he is able to shed light on any of this.

Kazagg Chah too had an ancestor who was never heard from again after disappearing one hundred years ago. Among his last writings, the following message was found. “The true power of destruction will be awoken in that most sacred of places.” After speaking with Kazagg Chah, you receive a timely linkpearl call from Ququruka. Contact him via linkpearl, and hear what he has to say.

The linkpearl message was not from Ququruka, but from Lalai. With an air of urgency, she demands that you return to Ul'dah at once. Hurry to the Milvaneth Sacrarium to learn what has caused her distress.

At the Milvaneth Sacrarium, Lalai debunks her former Master, telling you of a heinous crime he committed one hundred years ago. It seems Ququruka conspired with the beast tribes to create a monster, known as Barbatos, to destroy all of Eorzea. The black magic spoken of in the Ququruka's “prophecy” is not the key to sealing the Voidgate, but rather the key to opening it, unleashing Barbatos upon the realm. Hurry to Nald's Reflection, west of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan, and put an end to Ququruka's evil scheme.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Lulutsu of the Coliseum has given you some interesting news. For the first time in their history, the elite of the Sultansworn are prepared to teach the secret arts of the paladin to outsiders. If you wish to learn these skills, you will need to find the representative of the Sultansworn elite.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Lulutsu of the Coliseum has given you some interesting news. For the first time in their history, the elite of the Sultansworn are prepared to teach the secret arts of the paladin to outsiders. If you wish to learn these skills, seek out the captain of the Sultansworn elite. His name is Jenlyns, and he can be found near the Royal Promenade, in Ul'dah's Hustings Strip.

You have spoken to Jenlyns, captain of the Sultansworn. He is prepared to teach you the paladin skills, but only after you have proven yourself worthy. To that end, he tells you to travel to a way station called the Coffer & Coffin in western Thanalan, and thence head south to face the undead monsters that infest the area.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

As you finish off the last of the monsters, you are approached by a free paladin. He hands you a strange crystal and asks that you give it to Captain Jenlyns. Report back to Jenlyns at his station near the Royal Promenade, in Ul'dah's Hustings Strip.
※ The next paladin quest will be available from Jenlyns upon reaching level 35.

Jenlyns tells you that the elite of the Sultansworn have lost the respect that their good name once commanded, and the main reason is the theft of the sword Oathkeeper by a traitor. Jenlyns is hoping that your skills in battle will help him recover the sword, which has been passed down through generations of Sultansworn captains. To that end, he pledges to teach you more paladin skills and assigns a new task. You are to find and defeat the alux beast that lurks in the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars of the North Shroud.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

Jenlyns tells you that the elite of the Sultansworn have lost the respect that their good name once commanded, and the main reason is the theft of the sword Oathkeeper by a traitor. Jenlyns is hoping that your skills in battle will help him recover the sword, which has been passed down through generations of Sultansworn captains. To that end, he pledges to teach you more paladin skills and assigns a new task. You are to find and defeat the alux beast that lurks in the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars of the North Shroud.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
The next paladin quest will be available from Jenlyns upon reaching level 40.

You learn from Jenlyns that the traitor who stole the sword Oathkeeper is named Solkzagyl, and that he was a Sultansworn captain for thirty long years. The recovery of the sword will be very difficult, and Jenlyns pledges to teach you more of the paladin arts to prepare you for the fight. In order to properly hone your new skills, Jenlyns commands you to go to lower La Noscea and defeat the giant crab king, Old Six-arms.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

You learn from Jenlyns that the traitor who stole the sword Oathkeeper is named Solkzagyl, and that he was a Sultansworn captain for thirty long years. The recovery of the sword will be very difficult, and Jenlyns pledges to teach you more of the paladin arts to prepare you for the fight. In order to properly hone your new skills, Jenlyns commands you to go to lower La Noscea and defeat the giant crab king, Old Six-arms.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
※ The next paladin quest will be available from Jenlyns upon reaching level 45.

Jenlyns has uncovered archived records that point to a link between Solkzagyl and a faction within the Syndicate known as the Monetarists. While he continues his search for the missing traitor, Jenlyns asks you to recover the four pieces of the gallant armor. They can be found in these locations:[@CR]- Aurum Vale, west of Camp Ever Lakes in the Coerthas central lowlands.[@CR]- Natalan, east of Camp Dragonhead in the Coerthas central highlands.[@CR]- A cave north of Camp Brittlebark, in Mor Dhona.[@CR]- A cave northeast of Camp Crimson Bark, in the West Shroud.

Jenlyns has uncovered archived records that point to a link between Solkzagyl and a faction within the Syndicate known as the Monetarists. While he continues his search for the missing traitor, Jenlyns asks you to recover the four pieces of the gallant armor. They can be found in these locations:[@CR]- Aurum Vale, west of Camp Ever Lakes in the Coerthas central lowlands.[@CR]- Natalan, east of Camp Dragonhead in the Coerthas central highlands.[@CR]- A cave north of Camp Brittlebark, in Mor Dhona.[@CR]- A cave northeast of Camp Crimson Bark, in the West Shroud.
※ The next paladin quest is now available from Jenlyns.

Through intermediaries, Jenlyns has arranged a parley with Solkzagyl in order to negotiate the return of Oathkeeper. However, the meeting could be a trap, and Jenlyns has asked you to accompany him. The parley will be held on high ground in the northeast of Ul'dah.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Through intermediaries, Jenlyns has arranged a parley with Solkzagyl in order to negotiate the return of Oathkeeper. However, the meeting could be a trap, and Jenlyns has asked you to accompany him. The parley will be held on high ground in the northeast of Ul'dah.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

When you arrive at the parley, Jenlyns suddenly turns his sword against you and accuses you of being in league with Solkzagyl and the Monetarists. You have no time to explain or persuade him otherwise―if you want to live, your only choice is to fight Jenlyns and his soldiers.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
The next paladin quest will be available from Jenlyns upon reaching level 50.

Jenlyns has learned that he was an unwitting dupe of the Monetarists. But although his captaincy is a sham, he will use what power he has to strike back at the cabal. For the showdown, he has chosen an area southeast of Camp Bluefog, but he commands you to stay away and find a safe haven. What you do next is up to you and your conscience.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Jenlyns has learned that he was an unwitting dupe of the Monetarists. But although his captaincy is a sham, he will use what power he has to strike back at the cabal. For the showdown, he has chosen an area southeast of Camp Bluefog, but he commands you to stay away and find a safe haven. What you do next is up to you and your conscience.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

When you arrive at the battleground that Jenlyns has chosen to launch his campaign against the cabal, you find him and Solkzagyl facing off against the Monetarists' monster cohort. Help them fight off the attackers.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

You have defeated the monsters sent by the Monetarists. Solkzagyl leaves the Sultansworn in Jenlyns's hands and returns to his paladin's journey. Return to Ul'dah, find Jenlyns at his station near the Royal Promenade in the Hustings Strip, and talk to him once more.

title: A Song of Bards and Bowmen

journal_rows.english: At the Quiver's Hold, Georjeaux informs you that the legendary archer-turned-bard, Jehantel the Godsbow, has recently returned to the Twelveswood. Aspiring to transcendent mastery of the bow, several members of the Gods' Quiver have presented themselves as pupils to the legend. Alas, all have returned disappointed, as Jehantel offers only to teach poetry and verse. If you would learn from the man nonetheless, make your way north of Camp Tranquil, where he is said to have made his camp.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

At the Quiver's Hold, Georjeaux informs you that the legendary archer-turned-bard, Jehantel the Godsbow, has recently returned to the Twelveswood. Aspiring to transcendent mastery of the bow, several members of the Gods' Quiver have presented themselves as pupils to the legend. Alas, all have returned disappointed, as Jehantel offers only to teach poetry and verse. If you would learn from the man nonetheless, make your way north of Camp Tranquil, where he is said to have made his camp.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Having exchanged pleasantries with Jehantel, you astonish the kindly old bard by taking him up on his offer to teach you poetry and verse. He excitedly instructs you to present yourself to a moogle named Pukno Poki, who resides within a cave situated east of Camp Tranquil.

Speaking with Pukno Poki, the moogle prevails upon you to recover a stolen charm that was meant for Jehantel. The thief, a Qiqirn shirrer, was last seen fleeing to the east of Camp Tranquil.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
You have put down the Qiqirn shirrer and reclaimed Pukno Poki's stolen charm. See that the object is delivered to Jehantel, who awaits north of Camp Tranquil.
※ The next bard quest will be available from Jehantel upon reaching level 35.

You listen in bewilderment as Jehantel relates to you the origin of the bardic tradition. Apparently, bards were born when archers burst into song in order to cope with the stresses of battle. To drive the lesson home, Jehantel requires that you confront a lone jackal known as Bardi, who prowls the Nanawa Mines north of Ul'dah. In facing this foe in mortal combat and understanding what drives it, a new melody will surely reveal itself to you.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

To drive the lesson home, Jehantel requires that you confront a lone jackal known as Bardi, who prowls the Nanawa Mines north of Ul'dah. In facing this foe in mortal combat and understanding what drives it, a new melody will surely reveal itself to you.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
※ The next bard quest will be available from Jehantel upon reaching level 40.

You listen intently as Jehantel reveals that common bards also owe their existence to archers. According to him, the coming of peacetime left soldiers jobless, and many of those who had once bent the bow took to strumming the harp. Jehantel then offers to perform for you the Ballad of the Vainglorious Fool, but only if you first convince him that the lesson will not be lost upon you. Make your way to the Central Shroud and defeat the boar called Phaia, thereby proving your readiness.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

According to him, the coming of peacetime left soldiers jobless, and many of those who had once bent the bow took to strumming the harp. Jehantel then offers to perform for you the Ballad of the Vainglorious Fool, but only if you first convince him that the lesson will not be lost upon you. Make your way to the Central Shroud and defeat the boar called Phaia, thereby proving your readiness.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
※ The next bard quest will be available from Jehantel upon reaching level 45.

Jehantel sings for you the Ballad of the Vainglorious Fool, which depicts the events of the Massacre of Griffin Crossing, where an entire regiment of the Gods' Quiver was annihilated by the Ixal. Desiring that you demonstrate the fruits of your learning with bow in hand, Jehantel asks that you escort him to a place north of Hyrstmill.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Jehantel sings for you the Ballad of the Vainglorious Fool, which depicts the events of the Massacre of Griffin Crossing, where an entire regiment of the Gods' Quiver was annihilated by the Ixal. Desiring that you demonstrate the fruits of your learning with bow in hand, Jehantel asks that you escort him to a place north of Hyrstmill.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

En route to your destination, Jehantel spots an Ixali van, and a battle ensues. The erstwhile archer swiftly primes his bow, but inexplicably cannot bring himself to fire. You have no choice but to repel the enemy without his aid.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
※ The next bard quest is now available from Jehantel.

Jehantel declares you worthy of the choral attire, which he received from Pukno Poki when first they met in the Twelveswood. Having lost the will to live, however, Jehantel scattered the garments across the land, going to great pains to ensure that he would never see them again. The choral attire is yours, if you can but brave the perils of the following locations and retrieve them:[@CR]- Cutter's Cry, west of Camp Bluefog in northern Thanalan.[@CR]- Zahar'ak, east of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan.[@CR]- Turning Leaf, south of Camp Crimson Bark in the West Shroud.[@CR]- A cave south of Camp Iron Lake in upper La Noscea.

Jehantel declares you worthy of the choral attire, which he received from Pukno Poki when first they met in the Twelveswood. Having lost the will to live, however, Jehantel scattered the garments across the land, going to great pains to ensure that he would never see them again. The choral attire is yours, if you can but brave the perils of the following locations and retrieve them:[@CR]- Cutter's Cry, west of Camp Bluefog in northern Thanalan.[@CR]- Zahar'ak, east of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan.[@CR]- Turning Leaf, south of Camp Crimson Bark in the West Shroud.[@CR]- A cave south of Camp Iron Lake in upper La Noscea.
※ The next bard quest will be available from Jehantel upon reaching level 50.

After long years, Jehantel has finally mustered the courage to confront his inner demons, and bids you accompany him on a pilgrimage to the scene of his regiment's demise. Your destination is where the Griffin Crossing meets the central highlands of Coerthas. Once there, Jehantel intends to honor his fallen comrades with song, that their tormented souls might be laid to rest.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

After long years, Jehantel has finally mustered the courage to confront his inner demons, and bids you accompany him on a pilgrimage to the scene of his regiment's demise. Your destination is where the Griffin Crossing meets the central highlands of Coerthas. Once there, Jehantel intends to honor his fallen comrades with song, that their tormented souls might be laid to rest.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
Just as you arrive at your destination, an Ixali war band appears. After a fierce struggle, your party emerges victorious. With the area now secure, Jehantel may sing to his heart's content.

Haurtefert of the Wood Wailers has prevailed upon you to assist his Ishgardian acquaintance, a knight named Ser Alberic, in a matter of some sensitivity. The details of your task will be revealed when you meet the man at the Gates of Judgement, in the central highlands of Coerthas.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Haurtefert of the Wood Wailers has prevailed upon you to assist his Ishgardian acquaintance, a knight named Ser Alberic, in a matter of some sensitivity. The details of your task will be revealed when you meet the man at the Gates of Judgement, in the central highlands of Coerthas.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Upon meeting Ser Alberic, you learn that an Ishgardian relic of immeasurable worth called the Eye has been stolen. The thief, a dragoon named Estinien, is believed to have concealed himself in the vicinity of Camp Nine Ivies, in the East Shroud. Your task is to cull the fell creatures said to inhabit the area, that the search effort might proceed unhampered.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

In the midst of the culling, you find yourself confronted by a dragoon clad all in black. Just when it seemed that steel must clash, you become bathed in a mysterious light, an event which prompts your opponent's withdrawal. Who is the knight, and what is true nature of the light? Perhaps Ser Alberic can offer you some answers...
※ The next dragoon quest will be available from Alberic upon reaching level 35.

Ser Alberic relates to you the story of Haldrath, the first Azure Dragoon, who prized out the eye of the great wyrm Nidhogg a thousand years ago. With an unwavering sense of justice as his aegis, he prevailed over the power of the dragon and made it his own. Since that time, the Azure Dragoon has been the light of hope for Ishgard, the paragon of all dragoons. In order to wake the dragon within, Ser Alberic requires that you slay a monster called the bomb baron, who has grown agitated in the wake of a dragon attack. The creature can be found in Cassiopeia Hollow, east of Camp Bloodshore in eastern La Noscea.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

Ser Alberic relates to you the story of Haldrath, the first Azure Dragoon, who prized out the eye of the great wyrm Nidhogg a thousand years ago. With an unwavering sense of justice as his aegis, he prevailed over the power of the dragon and made it his own. Since that time, the Azure Dragoon has been the light of hope for Ishgard, the paragon of all dragoons. In order to wake the dragon within, Ser Alberic requires that you slay a monster called the bomb baron, who has grown agitated in the wake of a dragon attack. The creature can be found in Cassiopeia Hollow, east of Camp Bloodshore in eastern La Noscea.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
※ The next dragoon quest will be available from Alberic upon reaching level 40.

Ser Alberic recounts to you events of fifteen years past, when the great wyrm Nidhogg last awakened. As the Azure Dragoon, he met the beast in battle. While he succeeded in repelling it, he sustained grievous injuries that led to the loss of his powers. It was then that Ser Alberic met the young Estinien, who had been orphaned in the destruction. Now, the dragons are stirring once more, roused by the disturbance surrounding the Eye. Yet another dragon attack has occurred near Millers' Glade in the eastern lowlands of Coerthas, and a young dragoon was slain. Drawn by the scent of death, a creature named Spitfire has taken to desecrating his final resting place. Ser Alberic bids you slay the creature, that your comrade might know true peace.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

Ser Alberic recounts to you events of fifteen years past, when the great wyrm Nidhogg last awakened. As the Azure Dragoon, he met the beast in battle. While he succeeded in repelling it, he sustained grievous injuries that led to the loss of his powers. It was then that Ser Alberic met the young Estinien, who had been orphaned in the destruction. Now, the dragons are stirring once more, roused by the disturbance surrounding the Eye. Yet another dragon attack has occurred near Millers' Glade in the eastern lowlands of Coerthas, and a young dragoon was slain. Drawn by the scent of death, a creature named Spitfire has taken to desecrating his final resting place. Ser Alberic bids you slay the creature, that your comrade might know true peace.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
※ The next dragoon quest will be available from Alberic upon reaching level 45.

Ser Alberic has received a message from Estinien, the dragoon who made off with the Eye. The fugitive would trade words with you, and bids you meet him in the foothills southwest of Skyfire Locks. Take yourself to the rendezvous point, that you might learn of Estinien's intentions.

Ser Alberic has received a message from Estinien, the dragoon who made off with the Eye. The fugitive would trade words with you, and bids you meet him in the foothills southwest of Skyfire Locks. Take yourself to the rendezvous point, that you might learn of Estinien's intentions.

Estinien reveals that he took the Eye in order to divert Nidhogg's attention from Ishgard. The great wyrm stirs once more, and Estinien means to avenge his family and village by slaying it. Bidding you join your strength to his, he instructs you to acquire the drachen mail, a suit of armor forged of the blood of living dragons. The pieces have been sealed away at the following locations:[@CR]- The Aurum Vale, west of Camp Ever Lakes in the Coerthas central lowlands.[@CR]- The cave north of Camp Brittlebark in Mor Dhona.[@CR]- The U'Ghamaro Mines, northeast of Camp Iron Lake in upper La Noscea.[@CR]- The cave north of Camp Bluefog in northern Thanalan.
※ The next dragoon quest is now available from Alberic.

Ser Alberic confesses that he willingly relinquished the power of the dragon, fearing that it would corrupt him. Giving you stern warning never to forget whence comes your power, he bids you prove yourself worthy to champion the cause to which your lance is sworn. Take yourself to the western highlands of Coerthas, to an area south of Camp Riversmeet for which the camp is named. Once there, you are to seek out and slay the drake known as Stollenwurm.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that seven party members accompany you.

Ser Alberic confesses that he willingly relinquished the power of the dragon, fearing that it would corrupt him. Giving you stern warning never to forget whence comes your power, he bids you prove yourself worthy to champion the cause to which your lance is sworn. Take yourself to the western highlands of Coerthas, to an area south of Camp Riversmeet for which the camp is named. Once there, you are to seek out and slay the drake known as Stollenwurm.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that seven party members accompany you.
※ The next dragoon quest will be available from Alberic upon reaching level 50.

An urgent message has arrived from Estinien. Nidhogg is on the move, and your fellow Azure Dragoon bids you meet him at Griffin Crossing for the encounter. The southbound highroad will take you to the rendezvous point.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

An urgent message has arrived from Estinien. Nidhogg is on the move, and your fellow Azure Dragoon bids you meet him at Griffin Crossing for the encounter. The southbound highroad will take you to the rendezvous point.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

In an unexpected turn of events, Estinien makes known the rancor he harbors towards Ser Alberic for failing to protect his village fifteen years ago. A fierce struggle breaks out between the two Azure Dragoons, with you emerging the victor. Desperate, Estinien gives in to the great wyrm's seduction, whereupon a being of darkness manifests and advances upon you. Moments before you are devoured, however, the being inexplicably takes fright and fades into nothingness. Shaken by the experience but otherwise unharmed, Ser Alberic bids you meet him back at the Gates of Judgement.
